data.name: Surface Stranger (Underground)
data.description: You were born and raised in a subterranean home with little or no bright light. Your miss chance for concealment or total concealment due to either mundane or magical darkness decreases by 10%%. You are dazzled for 1 round when you are suddenly exposed to bright light.
